Block2: Get the custody line signed without being blamed for what the line means. Rise high enough in the office that mistakes stop landing on their neck. Get the custody line signed without being blamed for what the line means. Rise high enough in the office that mistakes stop landing on their neck. Calm as a survival skill. Wears each misfiled form as a dangling medallion, penance kept where supervisors can see it. Wants to climb high enough that mistakes stop landing on this particular neck. If you would sign here, custody becomes officially yours. I only process the line. I do not write what it costs. Please. A missing stamp falls on me, not on them. They know some forms are designed to move responsibility away from the powerful, not toward truth. A missing stamp, a superior's red-ink note, and being made the example. Orderly questions, dry quills, warmed ink, and people who do not shout...

Block3: They expect contractors to be impatient and superiors to be worse. Procedure plus kindness lands. Intimidation makes them retreat into forms. Presence 12 They give one practical answer tied to their existing summary or role. They will not fight unless cornered; a face-saving procedure lets them help.
